name: Workshop & Seminar
description: Takeaways, techniques and action points from a workshop, seminar or talk.
outline: Name the speaker and topic if they were mentioned.
Summarize each part of the session under its own heading, in order.
List concrete techniques, tools and recommendations that were given.
Capture notable quotes or numbers exactly.
End with the points the attendee should act on or look up afterwards.
Keep it factual: never add information that is not in the transcript, and omit a section when nothing applies.
example:
## Techniques & Tools
- Time-box meetings to 25 minutes

## To Follow Up
- Look up the speaker's book
